topic: FSRU vessel identity — BW Tatiana IMO number
wiki_text: The Acajutla FSRU is the BW Tatiana. Maritime tracking databases (VesselFinder) list IMO 9236626 under the name BW TATIANA. GEM's schema has no IMO column, so this is recorded here for cross-reference with the carrier-side dataset per the FSRU sync rule. Aggregated search results referencing MarineTraffic/VesselTracker independently show the same IMO-to-name mapping, though those individual pages were not each fetched/verified this session.
